lines.zh: 胸鳍张开，我要跃出去了。
lines.en: Pectoral fins spread — I'm leaping out.

lines.zh: 我们一群往同一个方向赶。
lines.en: My whole school hurries the same way.

lines.zh: 我摆尾太快，水花全溅起来。
lines.en: I beat my tail so fast the spray flies up.

lines.zh: 暖流推着我，我顺着它滑行。
lines.en: A warm current pushes me and I glide along it.

lines.zh: 我从同伴背下穿过，没碰着。
lines.en: I slip under a schoolmate's belly without touching it.

lines.zh: 我贴着浅海的沙脊游过去。
lines.en: I skim over the sand ridges of the shallows.

lines.zh: 我把胸鳍张开，像两片小帆。
lines.en: I spread my pectoral fins like two little sails.

lines.zh: 我游得很急，鳞片闪成一片光。
lines.en: I swim hard and my scales flash as one sheet of light.

lines.zh: 队伍拐弯，我跟着拐了个弧。
lines.en: The school turns and I swing through the same arc.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面，背鳍划开一层膜。
lines.en: Right at the surface, my dorsal fin splits the film.

lines.zh: 水太浅，我的肚皮蹭到沙。
lines.en: The water is so shallow my belly brushes sand.

lines.zh: 我冲出一小段，又落回队里。
lines.en: I dart ahead a short way and drop back into the school.

lines.zh: 同伴挤过来，我被推着走。
lines.en: A schoolmate crowds me and I am carried along.

lines.zh: 我绕着珊瑚转半圈才归队。
lines.en: I make half a loop around the coral before rejoining.

lines.zh: 我从浪尖上翻过去，又落进水里。
lines.en: I flip over the wave crest and fall back in.

lines.zh: 我滑过一段水面，鳍还没碰到水。
lines.en: I skim a stretch of surface, fins never touching.

lines.zh: 前面有影子，我立刻贴到沙上。
lines.en: A shadow ahead, and I drop to the sand.

lines.zh: 我挤进鱼群中间，那里最安全。
lines.en: I squeeze into the middle of the school. Safest there.

lines.zh: 我换了口气，又潜回暖流里。
lines.en: I take a breath and sink back into the warm current.

lines.zh: 我数着同伴的尾巴，一只不落。
lines.en: I count my schoolmates' tails. None missing.

lines.zh: 我浮到水面换了口气。
lines.en: I surface to take a breath of air.

lines.zh: 我们停在水层里，鳍慢慢摆。
lines.en: We hover in the water, fins waving slowly.

lines.zh: 光透过水面，我盯着那一片亮。
lines.en: Light pierces the surface and I stare at the brightness.

lines.zh: 我悬着不动，让水流替我走。
lines.en: I hang still and let the current carry me.

lines.zh: 同伴蹭了我一下，我没理。
lines.en: A schoolmate nudges me and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我把头探出水面，风有点凉。
lines.en: I poke my head out; the wind is a little cold.

lines.zh: 我嘴里含着气泡，慢慢吐掉。
lines.en: I hold a bubble in my mouth, then let it go.

lines.zh: 沙脊上没人，我就歇一会儿。
lines.en: No one is on the ridge, so I rest a while.

lines.zh: 我鳍一张一合，像在数拍子。
lines.en: My fins open and close as if counting beats.

lines.zh: 远处有影子，我看了一会儿。
lines.en: A shadow passes far off and I watch it briefly.

lines.zh: 我贴着海草边，动也不想动。
lines.en: Beside the seagrass I cannot be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 暖水流过鳃，我懒懒地摆尾。
lines.en: Warm water crosses my gills and I flick my tail lazily.

lines.zh: 我把身体倾斜，让阳光晒背。
lines.en: I tilt my body and let the sun warm my back.

lines.zh: 一群都静着，只有水声在响。
lines.en: The whole school is still and only the water speaks.

lines.zh: 我在水面上看着你的倒影。
lines.en: At the surface I watch your reflection.

lines.zh: 你靠近，我转了个方向对着你。
lines.en: You come near and I turn to face you.

lines.zh: 我从水下抬头，看见你的脸。
lines.en: I look up from underwater and see your face.

lines.zh: 我停在离你两臂远的地方。
lines.en: I stop two arm-lengths away from you.

lines.zh: 你的影子落下来，我避了一下。
lines.en: Your shadow falls and I flinch aside.

lines.zh: 我侧着身，一只眼睛盯着你。
lines.en: I turn side-on and fix one eye on you.

lines.zh: 你在岸边站着，我游到浅处。
lines.en: You stand on the shore and I swim into the shallows.

lines.zh: 我张嘴又合上，没吐泡泡。
lines.en: I open my mouth, close it, and blow no bubbles.

lines.zh: 你的手伸进水里，我退半尺。
lines.en: Your hand enters the water and I back off half a foot.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转了一圈才游开。
lines.en: I circle you once before swimming away.

lines.zh: 鳞被刮掉一片，水立刻红了。
lines.en: A patch of scales is scraped off and the water reddens.

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻肚，拼命正过身。
lines.en: Knocked belly-up, I struggle to right myself.

lines.zh: 侧鳍疼，我游得歪歪斜斜。
lines.en: My side fin hurts and I swim crookedly.

lines.zh: 鳞片被咬掉，我往深处坠。
lines.en: A bite tore off my scales; I sink deeper.

lines.zh: 我身上火辣辣，躲进群里。
lines.en: My body stings and I hide in the school.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，我得更快。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water, so I must go faster.

lines.zh: 我疼得跳出水面，又摔回来。
lines.en: The pain makes me leap out and crash back in.

lines.zh: 身体一侧不听使唤了。
lines.en: One side of my body will not obey me.

lines.zh: 我喘着，鳃一张一合很急。
lines.en: I gasp, gills snapping open and shut.

lines.zh: 我受了伤，同伴却先游走了。
lines.en: I am hurt, and my schoolmates swim off first.

lines.zh: 水里有碎屑，我立刻冲过去。
lines.en: Bits of food hit the water and I rush over.

lines.zh: 你撒下的东西在沉，我抢着吃。
lines.en: What you scatter is sinking; I snatch at it.

lines.zh: 气味散开，整群都朝那边游。
lines.en: The smell spreads and the whole school turns toward it.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的手边转，不敢咬。
lines.en: I circle your hand without daring to bite.

lines.zh: 那小团东西一亮，我就凑上去。
lines.en: A little morsel glints and I move in.

lines.zh: 饵沉得慢，我绕着它打转。
lines.en: The bait sinks slowly and I circle it.

lines.zh: 同伴先咬，我紧跟着挤进去。
lines.en: A schoolmate bites first and I squeeze in after.

lines.zh: 我一口吞下，又抬头等下一口。
lines.en: I swallow it and look up for the next bite.

lines.zh: 你手指一动，我误当成食物。
lines.en: Your finger twitches and I mistake it for food.

lines.zh: 我追着那点味道，游得很近。
lines.en: I chase that trace of smell and come very close.

lines.zh: 被撞得偏了方向，我甩尾稳住。
lines.en: Knocked off course, I flick my tail to steady myself.

lines.zh: 同伴撞我，我们一起翻了个身。
lines.en: A schoolmate hits me and we both roll over.

lines.zh: 我一头撞上珊瑚，鳞掉了两片。
lines.en: I headbutt the coral and lose two scales.

lines.zh: 你脚一动，我贴上又弹开。
lines.en: Your foot shifts; I touch it and bounce away.

lines.zh: 整群挤过来，我被推到边上。
lines.en: The school crowds in and I am pushed to the edge.

lines.zh: 我撞到浅滩的沙，溅起水花。
lines.en: I hit the shallow sand and throw up spray.

lines.zh: 谁的鳍扫到我，我转了两圈。
lines.en: A fin sweeps me and I spin twice.

lines.zh: 我被撞出水面，又摔回水里。
lines.en: I am knocked out of the water and crash back in.

lines.zh: 水把我推向石壁，我侧身卸力。
lines.en: Water shoves me at the rock and I turn to soften it.

lines.zh: 撞上渔网似的草，我挣了出来。
lines.en: I hit a net of weeds and wriggle free.

lines.zh: 我一个急停，后面的撞上我。
lines.en: I stop short and the one behind hits me.

lines.zh: 壳似的硬东西顶了我一下。
lines.en: Something hard like a shell butts me once.

lines.zh: 我绕着同伴转，鳍全张开。
lines.en: I circle my partner with every fin spread wide.

lines.zh: 我们肩并肩往浅处游。
lines.en: We swim shoulder to shoulder toward the shallows.

lines.zh: 我用尾拍水，给她听个响。
lines.en: I slap the water with my tail so she hears it.

lines.zh: 她游快，我追得水花四散。
lines.en: She speeds up and I chase, scattering spray.

lines.zh: 两只贴在一起，谁也没让开。
lines.en: We press together and neither gives way.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的一片鳞朝向她。
lines.en: I turn my brightest scale toward her.

lines.zh: 她停下，我也停下，谁也不动。
lines.en: She stops, I stop, and neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 我俩贴着浪尖，一起换气。
lines.en: We skim the wave crests and surface for air together.

lines.zh: 她躲进群里，我跟着钻进去。
lines.en: She hides in the school and I dive in after her.

lines.zh: 暖水正好，我们就在这待着。
lines.en: The warm water is perfect, so we stay here.

lines.zh: 我叼起一块碎屑，又掉了。
lines.en: I pick up a crumb and drop it again.

lines.zh: 嘴里太小，装不下这东西。
lines.en: My mouth is too small to hold this.

lines.zh: 我顶了顶那颗卵石，推不动。
lines.en: I butt a pebble and cannot move it.

lines.zh: 我含着一粒沙，吐了三次。
lines.en: I hold a grain of sand and spit it out three times.

lines.zh: 我把水草咬断，衔着游一段。
lines.en: I bite off seagrass and carry it a short way.

lines.zh: 东西太沉，我松口让它沉底。
lines.en: It is too heavy, so I let it sink.

lines.zh: 我用头顶着它往前挪了一寸。
lines.en: I push it with my head and shift it an inch.

lines.zh: 我抢到一口，马上被撞掉。
lines.en: I grab a bite and it is knocked away at once.

lines.zh: 我含着它，鳍都不敢大摆。
lines.en: I hold it in my mouth and barely dare to move my fins.

lines.zh: 它卡在嘴里，我慌张地甩头。
lines.en: It sticks in my mouth and I shake my head in panic.

lines.zh: 水面晃了一下，我立刻警觉。
lines.en: The surface ripples and I am instantly alert.

lines.zh: 大影子扫过，我知道那是什么。
lines.en: A big shadow sweeps past and I know what it is.

lines.zh: 有东西在追，我盯住它的方向。
lines.en: Something is hunting and I fix on its direction.

lines.zh: 我看见鲨鱼的背鳍，转身就走。
lines.en: I see a shark fin and turn away at once.

lines.zh: 那群小鱼散了，我锁定了来源。
lines.en: The small fish scatter and I pinpoint the source.

lines.zh: 我听见水被撞开的声音，怕了。
lines.en: I hear water being split and I am afraid.

lines.zh: 我定住一秒，认出了威胁。
lines.en: I hold still a second and recognize the threat.

lines.zh: 一个大家伙靠近，我转向逃。
lines.en: Something huge nears and I turn to flee.

lines.zh: 我把身体对准水面，准备起跳。
lines.en: I aim my body at the surface, ready to leap.

lines.zh: 它一露头，我就知道要跑。
lines.en: The moment it shows itself, I know I must run.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面游，尽量不出波纹。
lines.en: I swim at the surface, making as few ripples as I can.

lines.zh: 我盯着那影子，等它再靠近。
lines.en: I watch the shadow, waiting for it to come closer.

lines.zh: 我在它视线外绕了一小圈。
lines.en: I make a small loop outside its line of sight.

lines.zh: 我收窄鳍，把身体压平。
lines.en: I fold my fins in and flatten my body.

lines.zh: 它转过来，我立刻停住不动。
lines.en: It turns toward me and I stop dead.

lines.zh: 我数着它的速度，找空隙。
lines.en: I gauge its speed and look for a gap.

lines.zh: 我把自己藏在同伴们中间。
lines.en: I tuck myself in among my schoolmates.

lines.zh: 我瞄着浅滩的边，随时准备冲。
lines.en: I aim for the edge of the shallows, ready to bolt.

lines.zh: 它的嘴一张，我退了半尺。
lines.en: Its mouth opens and I retreat half a foot.

lines.zh: 我憋着气，等它走错一步。
lines.en: I hold my breath and wait for one wrong move.

lines.zh: 我咬它的鳍边，只留一个牙印。
lines.en: I bite its fin edge and leave only a tooth mark.

lines.zh: 我冲上去撞一下，马上逃开。
lines.en: I charge in for one hit and dart away.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴拍它的眼睛。
lines.en: I slap its eye with my tail.

lines.zh: 它张嘴，我钻进它的侧影里。
lines.en: It opens its mouth and I duck into its blind side.

lines.zh: 我扑上去咬，又被甩回水里。
lines.en: I lunge and bite, and am flung back into the water.

lines.zh: 我打得很凶，其实浑身在抖。
lines.en: I fight fiercely, though I am shaking all over.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，牙却咬不进去。
lines.en: I bite down but my teeth cannot pierce.

lines.zh: 我从侧面撞它，想逼它松开。
lines.en: I ram its flank to make it let go.

lines.zh: 我拼命跳起来，从它头上过。
lines.en: I leap for my life, right over its head.

lines.zh: 我撞得自己发晕，还是要打。
lines.en: I bash myself dizzy and still keep fighting.

lines.zh: 暖水一荡，我们一群落下来。
lines.en: The warm water stirs and our school drops in.

lines.zh: 我从浪里翻进这片浅海。
lines.en: I tumble in from the surf into these shallows.

lines.zh: 水温正好，我张开胸鳍。
lines.en: The water is just right and I spread my pectoral fins.

lines.zh: 我们八九条一起出现在水面。
lines.en: Eight or nine of us appear at the surface together.

lines.zh: 浅海的沙白得发亮，我停在上面。
lines.en: The shallow sand is bright white and I hover above it.

lines.zh: 浪把我推进海草丛，我游出来。
lines.en: A wave shoves me into the weeds and I swim back out.

lines.zh: 第一口气我是在水面上换的。
lines.en: My first breath is taken at the surface.

lines.zh: 我们挤成一团，然后散开游。
lines.en: We clump together, then scatter and swim.

lines.zh: 这片水面陌生，我先绕一圈。
lines.en: This water is new to me, so I circle it once.

lines.zh: 我落在暖流边上，正好歇脚。
lines.en: I land at the edge of the warm current, a fine place to rest.

lines.zh: 水面烫起来，我往深处钻。
lines.en: The surface turns hot and I dive deep.

lines.zh: 我摔在沙上，鳞片全进了沙。
lines.en: I hit the sand and scales fill with grit.

lines.zh: 我在空气里扑腾，鳃全干了。
lines.en: I flop in the air and my gills dry out.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我翻着飞出去。
lines.en: The water bursts and I tumble away.

lines.zh: 箭从水里穿过，扎进我的侧腹。
lines.en: An arrow cuts through the water into my flank.

lines.zh: 一股凉意钻进身体，我僵住了。
lines.en: A cold force enters me and I go rigid.

lines.zh: 饿得发虚，我连水都游不动。
lines.en: Weak with hunger, I can barely swim.

lines.zh: 雷落到海面，我整条都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea and my whole body goes numb.

lines.zh: 四周没水，我的鳍在空中乱拍。
lines.en: There is no water and my fins beat empty air.
